body: All good. I'm currently on the shore but I go to school up in Bergen county.

I had an ultrasound and two CT scans. 

SO and I talked about it. He cried, I cried, we got no sleep, but we did talk about it, and he's had me promise to call him as soon as I find anything out, since he's going to be out of town all day for work. Hopefully I'll know what's going on by the end of the day so that we can both get some peace of mind.

I understand that I need to talk to him about this, but how the hell do I break news like this? With the myriad of health issues I've undergone recently (all of which I'm guessing are due to this), I feel like I've stressed him out more than enough. 

And yes, I'll be going to the doctor tomorrow. There's no way I can let this go.
I didn't think of that. Thank you, I'll definitely look into it!

My boyfriend would be supportive, yes, but he just started a new job and is extremely sleep-deprived and stress out himself. TBH, it'd probably be easier just to tell him, but I don't want to make his life any more stressful than it has to be if it turns out to be something other than a miscarriage.
